analysis.title: Recorrelation drives vols higher // AI cross-asset hedges // SX5E vol // Equity longs // Yen vs CHF (UBS Sales and Trading Commentary, Shane Carroll, 10-Nov-2026)
key_insights: UBS S&T says re-correlation is helping drive some historic equity moves this week, but VIX is back below 20 and contagion so far is limited.
UBS Research's 'AI Disappoints' downside scenario points to potential hedges via Gold, Rates and SPX.
UBS Research favours owning European vol, with downside hedged via SX5E put-spreads.
UBS Research's preferred equity longs are NDX, KOSPI2 and Global Industrials. The desk suggests funding them by selling XLY calls.
UBS Research favours long Yen vs short CHF. Alternatives to play a rebound are NKY/JPY Hybrids and AUD/CHF Dual Digis.
The note is Sales and Trading commentary, not a UBS Research product. The charts and trade details sit in exhibits that were not extracted into the text.
